compiled_state.description:
## Context
Maintained guidance conflates generic HMAC manifest signatures with current plan-review and completion-verifier operation certificates. ADR 0044 defines the DSSE and SSHSIG substrate. ADR 0049 defines asymmetric, environment-attributed operation certificates and legacy compatibility.

## Plan
- Use the existing file-impact set as the positive edit scope: `README.md`, `docs/manifest-signing.md`, `docs/event-schema.md`, `docs/reuse-surface.md`, `docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md`, `docs/plan-review-gate.md`, and `docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl`.
- Classify each gate-adjacent signature statement in those files as current operation-certificate guidance, generic HMAC manifest/API guidance, legacy HMAC compatibility, or historical migration evidence.
- Make every current plan-review or completion-verifier statement identify all four implemented facts: a DSSE envelope, SSHSIG signing, an Ed25519 key, and environment-attributed signer identity.
- Make every legacy HMAC compatibility statement say that the record remains readable but cannot certify a current gated operation.
- Preserve generic HMAC manifest-signing guidance for other consumers. In `docs/reuse-surface.md`, change only incorrect gate-consumer attribution while retaining the source-contract statements pinned by `tests/unit/test_reuse_surface_doc.py`, including the generic `sign_manifest` API and hex-HMAC `compute_signature` result.
- Preserve ADR and migration history. Keep `src/rebar/_cli/help/sign.txt` and `docs/llm-framework.md` unchanged because their current statements are accurate.
- Use a one-time repository search plus an auditable per-file classification comment to detect omissions. This is review evidence, not a persistent string gate or mechanical prose-quality policy.
- Do not add mechanical writing enforcement. Do not change the Markdown-only reduced test policy.

## Verification
- Run `rg -n "HMAC|DSSE|SSHSIG|operation[- ]certificate" README.md docs src/rebar/_cli/help/sign.txt`, classify every gate-adjacent hit, and record the path plus classification in a ticket comment. Any hit outside the positive edit set must be recorded as accurate, historical, excluded, or follow-up scope before completion.
- Review `git diff -- README.md docs/manifest-signing.md docs/event-schema.md docs/reuse-surface.md docs/repo-snapshot-gates.md docs/plan-review-gate.md docs/sample-ticket-log.jsonl` against the four-fact current-certificate checklist and the explicit non-certifying legacy-HMAC checklist. Record the completed checklist in the ticket comment rather than adding an automated wording gate.
- Run `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` to prove documentation links and index entries remain valid.
- Run `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_reuse_surface_doc.py -q` to prove reusable generic-HMAC API documentation still matches the source contract.
- Run `python -m pytest tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_signature.py -q` to prove current and legacy signing lifecycle contracts remain green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Every changed current-gate statement identifies DSSE, SSHSIG, Ed25519, and environment attribution.
- [x] Every changed legacy-HMAC statement explicitly says it cannot certify current gated operations.
- [x] Generic HMAC manifest/API statements retain their implemented non-gate meaning.
- [x] A ticket comment classifies every gate-adjacent search hit by path and consumer role.
- [x] ADR and migration history remains intact.
- [x] `src/rebar/_cli/help/sign.txt` remains unchanged.
- [x] `docs/llm-framework.md` remains unchanged.
- [x] All commands in `## Verification` pass or produce the recorded classification evidence.
- [x] No persistent mechanical writing-enforcement check is introduced.
- [x] The Markdown-only reduced test policy remains unchanged.
